International Sports Timing (IST) is an American manufacturer of timing
systems, scoreboards, and related equipment for aquatic sports, based in Grand
Rapids, Michigan. It operates as a division of Industrial Service Technology,
Inc., an industrial automation and software company at the same Grand Rapids
address.[^home][^bbb][^parent] IST describes itself as a family-owned business
that has supplied swimming, diving, and water polo facilities since 1992, and
its products documented in this wiki are the
[SWIMSTART Electronic Start](../equipment/swimming/starter/swimstart.md) and the
[under-block lane speakers](../equipment/swimming/external-speaker/ist.md) sold
with it.[^home][^swimstart]

## History

Industrial Service Technology, Inc., IST's parent company, was incorporated in
Michigan in 1982 and supplies industrial hardware, custom inventory and
production software, and connectivity services.[^bbb][^parent] IST dates its
aquatic-timing operation to 1992.[^home] The Better Business Bureau lists
Industrial Service Technology, Inc. as the registered entity behind the
International Sports Timing name and names Ryan Julian as chief
executive.[^bbb]

The company remains active: its current online catalog carries touchpads,
starting systems, software, scoreboards, and clocks as of 2026.[^products]
Some accessory lines have left that catalog, however, including the under-block
lane speakers, whose status is documented as unclear on their own page.[^ubss]

## Products

IST's catalog covers hardware and software for running swimming, diving, and
water polo meets.[^home][^products]

- The [SWIMSTART Electronic Start](../equipment/swimming/starter/swimstart.md), a
  portable start system that packages a public-address system, start tone,
  strobe, and false-start recall in a battery-powered case.[^swimstart]
- The [under-block lane speakers](../equipment/swimming/external-speaker/ist.md),
  a set of 6 watt speakers on a multi-lane cable sold as an accessory to the
  SWIMSTART, together with 40 watt deck and far-end speakers.[^ubss]
- Touchpads in 60 inch and 78 inch sizes with a non-slip surface.[^products]
- Timing software, which IST offers as TimeWare (console software for teams using
  Hy-Tek Meet Manager) and MeetWare (a full meet and team management system),
  alongside WorkWare (workout management), PoloWare (water polo), and BoardWare
  (video scoreboard).[^products]
- Programmable digital pace clocks, including wireless two- and four-digit
  models.[^products]
- Electronic scoreboards in video matrix, projected video, and alphanumeric
  formats.[^products]
- Diving equipment, including the SWIMWARE handheld judge's scoring consoles,
  which IST describes as letting each judge enter a score directly into its
  TimeWare or MeetWare software.[^products]
- Water polo equipment, including a pace clock and shot clock, and DeckLight
  in-deck wiring.[^products]

## In swim timing

IST is one of several United States and international suppliers of pool timing
and scoring equipment, alongside [Colorado Time Systems](colorado-time-systems.md),
[Daktronics](daktronics.md), and Omega (Swiss Timing). Its SWIMSTART start output
is switchable between the normally-open contacts used by IST's own software,
Colorado Time Systems, and Daktronics consoles, and the normally-closed contacts
used by Omega consoles, so the starter can drive timing systems from more than
one manufacturer.[^swimstart]

## In competition

IST states that its timing equipment has been used by high schools, clubs,
colleges, YMCAs, and aquatic centers since 1992, and that it is the official
timing system of the National Interscholastic Swimming Coaches Association
(NISCA).[^home]
